slots.setting.bad.defaultMessage: That isn’t a slot setting Hive has.
slots.setting.bad.description: An error: a request to change a setting of “Slots and copies” named one that doesn’t exist.

slots.setting.badSize.defaultMessage: The number of review and check copies is a whole number from 1 to 32.
slots.setting.badSize.description: An error: the number of review and check copies given isn’t a whole number from 1 to 32.

slots.setting.badText.defaultMessage: A slot script or list of files is text of at most 4,000 characters.
slots.setting.badText.description: An error: a slot script or list of copied files given isn’t text, or is too long.
